name: PartnerCard
title: PartnerCard
summary: A linked card for one ISM partner: an initials tile, name, location, partner-type badges and a ↗ that fills black on hover.
whenToUse: Use in partner directories and on Global Bible Network region pages.
Use in grids of three or four, all with the same parts.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for radio stations with live status; use StationCard.
Do not use for people or staff profiles.

anatomy.description: The whole card is one link: head (initials + ↗), name and location, badges.

props.name: href
props.description: URL of the partner's page. The whole card is the link.

props.name: badges
props.description: One or two partner-type badges, e.g. "Church partner".

props.name: initials
props.default: derived from the first two words of `name`

props.name: tone
props.description: Initials tile colour; rotate so neighbours differ.

props.name: external
props.description: The link leaves ISM for the partner's own site: adds the hidden text.

variantNotes: Initials tile (56px, `--radius-md`), rotate colours so neighbours differ: States: default; hover (`--shadow-lift`, darker border, `.mn-go` fills black with a white ↗); focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`). Badges: one or two `.badge badge-partner` (Church partner, Translation partner, Radio partner).

states.documented: default; hover (`--shadow-lift`, darker border, `.mn-go` fills black with a white ↗); focus (2px Horizon Blue outline + `--shadow-focus`).
states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The card opens the partner's page, so it always shows ↗ in the 36px `.mn-go` circle. The whole card is the tap target.
Use initials (two letters) unless the partner supplied a logo cleared for use.
Name 18px 600; location 14px with a pin icon. One location line only.
Two badges at most; use `.badge-partner`, never status colours.
No buttons or extra links inside the card.
No Horizon Blue fill on the card; blue is used only for the focus ring and the blue initials variant.

accessibility: The link's accessible name is the card text (name, location, badges); the initials and ↗ are `aria-hidden="true"`.
If the link opens an external partner site, add "(opens partner site)" as visually hidden text.
Keep focus visible on the whole card.
content: Partner's official name, no abbreviations ("Hope Translation Society").
Partner names in the preview are samples.
